title: Prove modulatedPeriodization_surjective (Ch04 Sec5 sweep)
body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/Ch04_PeriodicSchauderBases/Sec5.lean` (session ADB991-claude-20261122-9335).

Closes #2654

**Proved:** `modulatedPeriodization_surjective` (Proposition 4.5.1.1(1), pp. 197–199), by the paper's cutoff argument (p. 199): with L = log|γ|, a smooth profile ρ(t) = H(t+L) − H(t) built from `Real.smoothTransition` satisfies Σₙ ρ(t+nL) = 1 and has compact support; for φ ∈ S(G/γ^ℤ), f(x) = ρ(log|x|)·φ(q x) is Bruhat smooth with compact support, hence lies in the decay space (`bruhatCompactSupport_le_modulatedExponentialDecay`), and its orbit sum is φ.

Only proofs and private lemmas, all directly above the theorem:
- `modulatedPeriodization_surjective_mul`: Bruhat Cᵖ is closed under products (same argument as `IsBruhatContDiff.add`).
- `modulatedPeriodization_surjective_comp_mk`: Bruhat Cᵖ pulls back along the quotient by a closed subgroup (via `exists_good_subgroup_image_in_kernel`, `bruhatStructuralPair_quotient_map`, `BruhatStructuralPair.exists_quotient_hom`, `bruhatContDiff_descend_of_le`, `contDiff_comp_elementaryHom`).
- `modulatedPeriodization_surjective_log_compact`, `modulatedPeriodization_surjective_logProfile`: compact subgroups lie in ker log|·|, and ρ ∘ log|·| is Bruhat smooth.
- `modulatedPeriodization_surjective_cutoff`, `_profile`, `_window`: the cutoff product, the telescoping profile, compactness of log-windows.

New imports: `Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.SmoothTransition`, and `import all` of `AppD_SchwartzBruhat.Sec1b` and `Sec1c` for their private descent lemmas (Sec4 already uses `import all` the same way).

**Checks run:** `lake build` (full, 18852 jobs) passes; `scripts/lint.sh` ok; `scripts/signatures.sh --compare` on the module's signatures before/after (generated with `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.Ch04_PeriodicSchauderBases.Sec5`) reports no changed statement. `lake build` of the module took about 110 s, against 106 s before.

`#print axioms RiemannMasullo.modulatedPeriodization_surjective`: `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes from the statement: `#print axioms RiemannMasullo.modulatedPeriodizationCLM` already shows it (as does `schwartzBruhat_isBruhatSmooth`). Downstream, `modulatedPeriodization_isOpenMap`, `modulatedIsotypicPeriodization_isClosed_range`, `modulatedPeriodization_isClosed_isotype_image` and `modulatedIntervalPeriodization_factorization` used this theorem and no longer rest on its `sorry`.

The other open proofs of the file (#2667 #2688 #2691 #2693 #2694 #2696 #2708 #2711) were claimed and are released with notes on each issue.
